storyAc14After: 14. **AC-14 — Audit table and rows (SEC-9, I-C10).** `studio_secret_use_audit` is append-only (UPDATE/DELETE refused by trigger) with the §4.1 columns (`path ∈ {GUIDED, OBSERVED_REPLAY}`, `execution_id?`, `session_id?`, `admission_id?`, `principal_id`, `csi_id`, `environment`, `test_id`, `secret_id`, `vault_version?`) plus `row_kind ∈ {RELEASE, USAGE}`, `release_id`, `attempt_id`, `release_seq`, `coordinate_step_id` + `coordinate_ordinal`, and `outcome ∈ {RESOLVED, NOT_AUTHORIZED, REVOKED, UNAVAILABLE, VAULT_UNAVAILABLE, REVOKED_MID_RUN}`; never a value (canary scan of the table). Rows are written in the same transaction as the dispatch state change on both paths: one RELEASE row per release including every retry (two rows, two `attempt_id`s on a forced retry); one USAGE row per declared secret — guided joined from the ledger outcome by `admission_id` when an admission exists, replay from `RunnerReport.secretUse` — so a resolved-but-never-typed secret is `NOT_USED` (C-11). Resolution `outcome` is nonnull for every actual RELEASE and linked USAGE and remains exactly the six outcomes above; `usage_outcome` records usage separately. **Sole absence variant:** a guided declared-but-unreached secret has one terminal `USAGE/NOT_USED` row with null `outcome`, `release_id`, `admission_id` and `vault_version`, exact declaring `coordinate_step_id`/`coordinate_ordinal` and session/attempt/principal/CSI/environment/test/secret identity, and duplicate/concurrent summaries refused. Null means no resolution decision occurred, never a new outcome code; no RELEASE, admission, version or resolution fact is fabricated and no Vault read or runner send occurs to satisfy the audit relationship. Every other USAGE requires its actual scoped RELEASE. C-11 proves this zero-read/zero-send absence case, distinct from resolved-but-not-typed usage, rejects null outcomes on actual RELEASE/linked USAGE and malformed or wrong-scope links, and retains the audit value-canary scan. Retention: the existing retention pruner window (design §8 Q3 default). DDL authored by @data-engineer as `V34__studio_guided_secret_login.sql` on the **current** baseline; OBS-012A re-homes it into `V17__secret_use_audit` (ADR-SC-005 D-B). [design §4.1, §4.6 I-C10, §6 "Migration"; security review F-8]

rationale: Original one-USAGE-per-declared-secret obligation includes steps never reached; guided dispatch is just-in-time so that case truthfully has no resolved value or RELEASE.
Fabricating RESOLVED, a RELEASE, an admission or a Vault version would falsify audit evidence; reading Vault merely to populate those fields would violate right-moment delivery.

Nullable resolution outcome is permitted only for the fully constrained GUIDED terminal USAGE/NOT_USED absence shape. It adds no new resolution outcome code and never makes actual release facts optional.
Every actual RELEASE/linked USAGE remains nonnull in exactly RESOLVED, NOT_AUTHORIZED, REVOKED, UNAVAILABLE, VAULT_UNAVAILABLE, REVOKED_MID_RUN. All other usage requires the real scoped RELEASE.

Append-only metadata, complete authorization scope and declarative coordinates, uniqueness, retention window and value-canary coverage are preserved. No value, diagnostic text, new secret channel or account-provider feature is added.

AC-13 mid-run revocation remains required. RULING-6 live recheck event is safe metadata, linked to prior resolution, no send/value, immutable and unique; this PO delta does not claim SQL or runtime proof.
